text: A chemical factory in Pune emitted sulfur dioxide causing air pollution in the region.
Raw sewage discharged into Mutha river caused water pollution in Pune city.
Construction activity in Noida caused severe dust and particulate matter emissions.
Pesticide accumulation in farm soil in Punjab resulted in soil pollution.
Nighttime truck traffic generated loud noise pollution near Delhi residential zones.
Oil refinery flaring released methane into atmospheric air near Jamnagar.
Industrial waste dumping near riverbank caused heavy metal soil pollution in Durgapur.
Mining operations created thick dust smog and PM10 pollution in Bellary.
Untreated factory wastewater polluted agricultural land near Tirupur.
Loudspeakers and industrial equipment created noise pollution in Jamshedpur.
